1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 g6 3.g3 Bg7 4.Bg2 O-O 5.O.strategy: Mirrors Black: the king is safe behind its bishop and the set-up is symmetrical. White keeps the decisive choice in hand, whether to claim space on the queenside.

Stakes the centre at once with a pawn instead of waiting with a quieter pawn move. The pawn takes c4 and e4 under control, and the bishop on g7 gets the long diagonal if the centre opens, so White cannot easily claim the whole centre.
